components.name: Echo
components.summary: The Echo is Envoi Labs's signature 3D object, a glossy pink sound blob that is the record button for respondents and the agent's presence for researchers.

components.name: AgentChat
components.summary: The scoping conversation between a researcher and the Envoi agent, the left half of the scoping screen.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Pill-shaped buttons in four variants, verb first and sentence case.

components.name: EarningsChip
components.summary: The lime pill that tells a respondent what they will earn, paired with the question progress track.

components.name: FillTracker
components.summary: The live progress card on a launched study, showing how far fieldwork has come and whether it will fill on time.

components.name: FindingCard
components.summary: One theme in a study report, stated as a claim with the evidence that backs it.

components.name: InviteCard
components.summary: The offer a respondent sees before accepting a study, built so the decision takes three seconds.

components.name: ResearcherScoping
components.summary: The researcher's first screen, a conversation with the agent on the left and the study brief building itself on the right.

components.name: RespondentInterview
components.summary: The core respondent screen, one interview question answered by voice on a phone.

components.name: StatusChip
components.summary: Small pills for state, criteria and labels, always a word with an optional icon.

components.name: StudyBrief
components.summary: The live one-page brief that fills in beside the scoping chat and ends in the quote, the right half of the scoping screen.

components.name: VoiceAnswer
components.summary: How a respondent's spoken answer, the agent's live follow-up and the recording state appear in the interview thread.
